standard_prerequisites.name: Diagonal construction
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the closed complement E whose openness is now to be upgraded.

standard_prerequisites.name: Closedness of the parts
standard_prerequisites.use: Z_1, Z_2 closed in T' x_Y X.

standard_prerequisites.name: Openness of flat finitely presented morphisms
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms of Spaces lemmas base-change-finite-presentation, base-change-flat, fppf-open (cross-chapter, named block)
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes pr_0|_{Z_1} open so that E is open.

standard_prerequisites.name: Representability of locally quasi-finite separated morphisms
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms of Spaces lemmas etale-locally-quasi-finite and locally-quasi-finite-separated-representable, proposition locally-quasi-finite-separated-over-scheme (cross-chapter, named block)
standard_prerequisites.use: Closes representable and the scheme case.

core_obligations: Recall from the diagonal lemma that separatedness reduces to E being closed; here show E is also open.
Use Z_1 closed, the openness of Z_1 minus the intersection inside Z_1, and flat+finitely-presented pr_0|_{Z_1} to make both image pieces open.
Conclude separatedness; etaleness already known gives locally quasi-finite plus separated, hence representable.
Get the scheme case from the proposition on locally quasi-finite separated spaces over schemes.
proof_roadmap: Openness upgrade of the diagonal's complement via flatness, then the representability chain.
difficulty_reason: The openness of E is the real step; the rest is a precise lemma chain.
